candidate.answerReason: Exchanging one ten changes 70 into 6 tens and 10 ones. Subtracting 2 tens and 6 ones leaves 4 tens and 4 ones, or 44.

methods.label: Subtraction with borrowing
methods.explanation: Subtracting 6 from 0 requires borrowing. Exchange 1 ten for 10 ones, changing 70 from 7 tens and 0 ones to 6 tens and 10 ones. Subtracting 26 leaves \(10-6=4\) ones and \(6-2=4\) tens. \(70-26=44\).
methods.levelReason: Borrowing from the tens place when the ones digit is zero fits the supplied Grade 1 subtraction scope.
